message: COMPOSER_POLICY=0 in the env of the workflow in .github/workflows/ci.yml reaches every Composer command there and turns off every dependency policy, the cooldown included
fix: Remove COMPOSER_POLICY from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml, or set it only for a run that needs it after reviewing the packages

message: COMPOSER_POLICY_COOLDOWN_PERIOD=1 day in the env of job test in .github/workflows/ci.yml reaches every Composer command there and replaces the cooldown period with 1 day, shorter than the 3d of depcurfew.json
fix: Remove COMPOSER_POLICY_COOLDOWN_PERIOD from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml, or set it only for a run that needs it after reviewing the packages

message: COMPOSER_POLICY_MALWARE_BLOCK=off in the env of job test in .github/workflows/ci.yml reaches every Composer command there and stops blocking versions flagged as malware
fix: Remove COMPOSER_POLICY_MALWARE_BLOCK from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml, or set it only for a run that needs it after reviewing the packages

message: COMPOSER_NO_BLOCKING=false in the env of step 2 of job test in .github/workflows/ci.yml reaches every Composer command there and turns off all policy blocking, the cooldown included (Composer takes every value but "" and "0" for yes)
fix: Remove COMPOSER_NO_BLOCKING from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml, or set it only for a run that needs it after reviewing the packages

message: COMPOSER_POLICY_COOLDOWN_BLOCK=${{ matrix.block }} in the env of step 2 of job test in .github/workflows/ci.yml reaches every Composer command there and may stop the cooldown from withholding new versions
fix: Remove COMPOSER_POLICY_COOLDOWN_BLOCK from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml, or set it only for a run that needs it after reviewing the packages
